text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The purple haskap jam that splattered onto the uniform...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The uniform is purple too, though,
so maybe I can blend this in—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...It won't, huh.
*sigh* I guess I'll just have to scrub it out somehow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hokko Tarumae ended up feeling down
after getting her uniform dirty."
